name: Mining Consultant
objectives: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

name: Rough Wolf Pelts
objectives: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

name: The Big Picture
objectives: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.
Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. ...

name: Follow That Kobold!
objectives: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.
Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. ...

name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
objectives: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
description:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.
Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

name: Book Return
objectives: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
description: While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. ...

name: Rare Books
objectives: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

name: A Scribbled Letter
objectives: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.

name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
objectives: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

name: The Problem With Prideclaws
objectives: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
description: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. ...

name: Hippogryph Harassment
objectives: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

name: The Criminal Element
objectives: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. ...

name: Among the Faithful
objectives: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

name: Falaath Village
objectives:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.
If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

name: Havoc in the Highlands
objectives: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

name: Stolen Supplies
objectives: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.

name: Restocking the Larders
objectives: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village ...
